title: New AI is very strong – level 1
paragraphs: A US company makes a new and very strong AI. It is called Claude Mythos.

This AI understands computer code perfectly. It can find mistakes in computer programs very fast. This is scary. Bad people may use the AI to hack computers in banks, factories, or the army. The company wants to keep the AI safe. Therefore, only a few people in the US can use it. Other countries, like India, also want to use this AI to protect their computers.
In February 2026, politicians meet to talk about AI. They want to make safe rules for all world. It is very difficult because every country wants to have the best technology.

words.d: when something makes you feel worried
to use a computer to steal data from another computer
